author: Hurley
body: As the description states, the cushion and back of this chair is made of a dragon mesh, providing a comfortable and durable, ventilated and breathable seat.  The arm rests can be adjusted 90 degrees which allows the chair to move freely under a desk.  A lumbar pillow is attached to the back and provides comfort for your back when setting for long periods of time.  This chair is easy to assemble.  The hardware (screws, washers, etc) are packed in a card making the parts easy to identify.  The instruction booklet explains every step in the assembly process.  This chair provides a comfortable seat for office, home or just to rest and relax.

author: Donald L.
body: My wife's computer chair needed replacing, so I thought I would get her this one.  Excellent choice.  This chair is very well made out of good quality materials.  Fit and finish are excellent.  Assembly is simple using the included T-handle hex wrench.  The instructions are well written with clear illustrations.  Assembly hardware is bubble packed with each step packed together and clearly marked.  Each step also includes a spare nut or bolt.  This chair is very well designed and engineered.  Has adjustable height, headrest,  and armrests.  Built-in lumbar support.  It even has a hangar for a coat on the rear of the chair.  Very comfortable for extended sitting. If I could I would give it six stars.  Very highly recommended. 5 stars.

author: Bill in T.
body: Once assembled the SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair is very comfortable.  The tension of the ease of leaning back can be adjusted by the adjustment knob located at the bottom of the seat.  The two side arms can be raised so as to make the chair a side less desk chair.  The mesh seat and back are comfortable and do provide support but be aware what they are not as cushy as one might be accustomed to so an additional seat cushion might be wanted by some.  The lumbar support is adequate and a nice feature.It comes in a very large box that protects the inner box that actually contains the contents of the chair parts.  it is well packed.  It contains all the parts and instructions and the instructions are well written and easy to follow.  It even has the necessary tool for putting the chair together.  While I was able to assemble the chair by myself (even with severe arthritis is one hand) it would have been easier to have a 2nd person to assist.I do find that the tilting and rocking of the back is a little difficult to find the correct position to find the perfect angle for my liking and it doesn't take too much backward pressure to loose its lock in holding that said position. But that is not a deal stopper in my enjoyment in using this chair.

author: LVGoodguy
body: The SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair has completely upgraded my workspace! The 3D flip armrests are a great feature, allowing me to position them perfectly for typing or flip them up to save space. The 3D headrest provides excellent neck support, which has really helped reduce neck strain during long work sessions.The adjustable lumbar support and seat height ensure a custom fit, and the chair is incredibly comfortable, with a design that keeps my posture in check. The materials feel durable, and the chair is solidly built without being too heavy to move. This chair has everything I need for comfort and support, making it well worth the investment. Highly recommend for anyone looking for an ergonomic, high-quality chair!

author: KBENNETT
body: This was relatively easy to assemble which was a plus. The breathable mesh fabric is great for not retaining heat. I like the arm rests that can lift out of the way when you don't want to use them. The lumbar support and head rest are nice but not adjustable so they may not fit your body well depending on your height and build. The lumbar support is comfortable for me at 5'4 but not as much for my 6'3 husband. The head rest is too tall for me but perfect for my husband. I am also unsure how well it hold up over time for regular use by a person who weighs more than 160 pounds. It's fine for me but my larger husband has noticeable seat sagging, he's 230 pounds.  It's a decent chair but the not at this price point. If you catch it on sale or with a good coupon it's a worthy purchase but not at  full price which was $249.99 at time of review.

author: Optimus P.
body: I got this desk chair for my home office, to replace a worn one.  I wanted something that was comfortable and offered support for my back and neck, so I do not get sore while sitting all day at the home office.  I also wanted mesh, so it breathed.This chair is well designed.  It has mesh in the back section, to keep one's back from sweating while seated for hours at work, and the seat is mesh, so cooler there as well.  It has decent lumbar support, so one's back does not get sore (a real plus), and even a headrest that goes high enough to actually lay one's head on.  This is good to keep away the neck pain you can get from short chairs that do not offer neck support.This chair leans nicely if one wants to rest a bit (combined with the mentioned neck and lumbar support to let one rest and wake up not being sore).  It has a little bar in the back to drape one's suit jacket on.  So, they would work well even in a professional office.  As I am in a home office and wearing shorts while I work, I will never use it, but it is there nonetheless, and a thoughtful addition for the professional.For $249, the price is good for the quality you get.  Assembly took about 10 minutes. While they even give you the required Allen wrench in the kit, I recommend using an impact driver on the lowest setting with a 5mm hex bit (all the screws are the same 5mm head).  That really makes assembly easy.

author: Saundra W.
body: This has light, airy mesh that is surprisingly supportive. The arms are fully adjustable and can even be flipped up to go under desk. It was quite easy to put together. The chair is very sturdy and holds weights up to 330 pounds. It's a bit pricey but I believe it's worth the money for the comfort.

author: Rachel
body: I've been looking for like the perfect office chair for a long time. I'm tall with long legs, and I thought I preferred a very comfortable chair over a modern ergonomic kind. But this chair changed my mind. I really didn't have high expectations for it. But after sitting in it for several days, I can now confidently say that it's replaced my upright drafting chair, and even my Haworth Very chair valued at $600. The adjustability is its key feature, with lots of headrest adjustment, arm rest forward and backward, flipped up or down, and the standard height + tilt lock and tension adjustments. For me, I was at first confused by the unadjustable lumbar rest, but they have this unique spring loaded mechanism that kinda lets the lumbar support conform to your back even without adjusting it up or down. Overall, I've experienced less pain in this chair than any other office chair I've used thus far. And I think I've tried out like 6 different office chairs long term.I would say the quality meets a $200 chair, especially the mesh having nice patterning to it. This is not a cushiony chair. This is an ergonomic chair that may help you not feel pain after a day of sitting.

author: hjh
body: I like it. Its excellent if your looking for adjustability and support. Its particularly good if you need reliable lumbar support. It also has customizable are and head rest options. If your looking to be more productive and comfortable while your doing it, This is it~! Recommended~!

author: Derek
body: I find the bottom very comfortable. I've read other comments that they didn't but I most definitely do.  It is just a webbing material but it is strong and I fit nicely into it.  I like the lower lumbar support.  Everything about this chair is really nice too me.  I did think the arms didn't extend enough but you can pull them out and even adjust the angle of them.  It rolls decently.  I am on hardwood and have no issues.  Very easy to put together.  I think it is 4 sets of screws and comes with a nice t handle Allen wrench to get the job done.  I'm 6'2 and weigh 265 lbs and I'm telling you this thing handles me well.  I'm very pleased with it.  The back reclines pretty far I could easily kick my feet up on something and go to sleep comfortably.  I like the design in the webbing the chair is made up with.  It is expensive but I wouldn't be mad sitting in this working for hours.

author: Jeff
body: I use a 700$ eurotech chair at work and this chair absolutely is just as comfortable.  It doesn't have as much seat slide adjustment.  You can shuffle it slightly by where the 3 backrest bolts attach to the seat.  The chair is absolutely sturdy.  I actually like this chairs lumbar section feature more than what's on my work chair.  It doesnt have a setting to change though.  It relies on the placement of it adding its plastic shock absorber looking parts to flex and have contact pressure.  I found it absolutely satisfying. The headrest has nice adjustments and way better than more limited than I'm used to.  Up down tilt and angle.  Able to have it as neck support or more just a headrest for me.  It does have some weight to it, but rolls great and the fact wheel arms, frame, and chair parts have weight, adds to its feel of stability and more hope that it'll last well.The armrests aren't able to go up and down but I prefer they can swing up like this chair.  The arm pads click inward and outward as well as forward several clicks.  The pad isn't soft or plus but has just enough padding to not be uncomfortable.The one funny was the armrest bolt covers were backwards labeled.  My Left ones went on the right side and Right on left side.  There's a little slant in the mold that made it clear when it's in the correct side.The manual is quite well done.  Detailed enough and worded good.  Good number of languages represented too.Being a third of the price of a chair I sit at work in and I'd pick sitting in this one.  May need to take it to work.......Oh.  and a coat hanger built in is quite neat!  Nice to not just drape it over the back ledge and have an actual hanger right there to put something on.

author: Turner R.
body: I have been on the hunt for the right office chair for my needs, and this chair is actually pretty nice.  I find it pretty comfortable, and as they say, it fits pretty ergonomically to my body.  I had another chair that just didn't feel right, but this one feels better when I sit in it and lean back, as in it feels supportive.  I like that the armrests clip up, so when I push the chair in, I can push the chair in all the way since the arms are out of the way.  The headrest is pretty nice as well, and overall, this was fairly easy to put together in about a half hour.  I am also glad this has a lumbar support, as my back has been hurting lately, and that definitely helps.  As I said in the beginning, this is a pretty nice office chair.

author: Darocaro2014
body: I really like this Office Chair. This has indeed made a difference in my daily work. I do spend long hours at desks, and this chair made quite a difference in terms of comfort and support. The lumbar feels just right, just positioned right without feeling any stiff or uncomfortable feeling.The 3D flip armrests and headrest are just a piece of thoughtfulness. I can easily move them depending on what I am working on, and the headrest provides such great support, especially when I lean back during breaks. The seat itself has great cushioning, and I really appreciate the adjustability in height that lets me find that perfect alignment with my desk.I found assembly to be pretty hassle-free, and the quality of the materials seems top-shelf. Overall, this chair really took my home office setup to a whole new level-the feeling is that I literally look forward to sitting in it each day.

author: George B.
body: The Good:This chair overall is a decent chair.  I am tall, and this chair adjust taller than most of the other office chairs I have used.  This might be because of the different wheels i put on it, but i do find i cannot have it at the full height because it is too high then.The arm rest turn in and out.  This helps you find a comfortable spot to rest your elbows.The headrest adjusts up and down.The Bad:The Wheels could be better.  We have hardwood floors and I use high-end rubber style wheels.  I ended up using the upgraded wheels off of my other chair.The Lumbar support is too low.  It is more on my tailbone than my lumbar.  There is no way to adjust up.  When you lay back, it does become better, but I am mostly sitting up and it does not help in that position.This is great in the summer, chilly in the winter.  The net type of seat and back rest is great for ventilation.  My office is in the basement, and it is chilly down there in the winter, so this netter does not help keep my back and back side warm.The Ugly:Nothing Ugly to mention.  again, overall, this is a great chair except for the few things above.  Your mission, if you decide to take it, is to test it out for yourself and decide if the price is worth it.

author: RogueOne2406
body: This office chair is probably one of the best ones that I have owned. It took roughly 25 minutes to start to finish to put together. The instructions were very clear. Every part in this box came flawless with no imperfections and once put together I could not believe how comfortable this chair was. It is definitely tall people friendly. The chairs mesh design pattern is gorgeous. The back and lumbar support feels great especially for me. I'm only 6ft but the height is enough for me to feel like my legs are just slightly off the floor. The chair has adjustable arms that can be raised up or left down. I was so impressed with the look of the base legs, they look very classy. This chair is worth evey penny. My son even preferred it over his more expensive gaming chair and he's 6'2'. Great chair!

author: T3ch5upp0rt
body: I purchased a Sihoo Doro C300 earlier this year.  When I saw this chair, I thought I can always use a 2nd chair in my office.  This is now MY PRIMARY CHAIR.  It's the MOST comfortable office chair I've ever sat in.  Both Sihoo chairs were well packaged and easy to put together.  Both are exceptionally comfortable, but in the end, I prefer the M59AS slightly over my Doro C300.  It rolls great on my LVP flooring.  Adjustable headrest and flip up arms are great.  This is a sturdy, high-quality, comfortable chair. I recommend it!

author: Edward P.
body: Great deal for a well made and sturdy desk chair. The large chair is completely adjustable and ergonomic for total comfort. The chair is very easy to assemble with all hardware included. The chair operated quietly and rolls smoothly on carpet friendly casters.

author: Merc
body: If Covid taught me anything it is that you can't skimp on an ergo chair while chained to your home office 10 hours a day.  Okay, this is not a $1000 Steelcase or Herman Miller, but for a budget chair it is exceptional.  Understand it is a mesh chair not a cushioned chair so expect great support and airflow not a plush feel. For some, it is an acquired appreciation and it may not seem comfortable at first, but there is a reason many of those high-end chairs are mesh and not foam.  I had to be convinced too, but now I'm a convert.  After the first 10 hours in the saddle you'll figure out if you like it or not.This chair is very comfortable, has great lumbar support and a nice adjustable headrest is standard.  I wish the arms were more adjustable, but they do swing out of the way which I find handy.  One of the great things about this chair is that it works well for larger people.  I'm 6' 1, 220lbs and it fits me great.  My 14 year old grandson is 6' 4, 180lbs and he uses it as a gaming chair and says it is very comfortable.Bottom line, you can't compare this to a $1000 chair, but compared to other chairs in the same price class this is a 5 star product all day long.

author: Jinjer p.
body: This SIHOO ergonomic office chair is really nice!The chair comes in pieces and needs to be assembled. Plan for 220-30 minutes to assemble everything and it would help to have a second person but not necessary. The instructions for this chair are probably the most thorough that I have seen for an office chair. The drawings and identification of each part is easy to follow. The bolds and screws are easy to identify as well, they come on a piece of cardboard with plastic over the screws and bolts and a label for each. The other nice part is the label on the screws and bolts actually tells you how many of each and that it includes extra, so you are not thinking, why do I have an extra screw??.The assembly went smooth with this chair and once I sat in the chair, I thought it was very comfortable on my bottom and very supportive to my back. The wheels glide very smoothly on the floor and the adjustments to lower and raise the chair and lock the chair all work and are easy to operate. I love that the armrests can be lifted!Now the reason I do not give this five stars, the arm rests are too short for me. I'm a bigger guy and this is likely the reason it feels like these are too short. I felt like these did not give enough support to my arm when typing. Luckily, I bought some arm pads to go over the armrests and this added enough support for me to use this daily.Overall, the chair is very comfortable, easy to assemble, well made.

author: Mancave C.
body: While assembling office chairs like this are one of my least favorite things, this chair was not that bad. The quality of the manufacturing was great and the adjustability of the arm and head rests all provided the right amount of comfort. The wheels roll nicely and the chair is comfortable to sit in. That's all that matters.

author: PM2016
body: Nice chair, limited adjustments, but comfortable.  Seat moves up and down, arms raise, and head/neck adjusts.  Assembly was straight forward with clear instructions, about 45 minutes.Comfortable, a great replacement for my worn out desk chair!

author: Otter P.
body: This is a super great chair!It is comfortable and adjustable in every way including lumbar, neck, arms, everything.The fabric is strong and breathable.Assembly - instructions excellent and readable. Zero problems putting it together. I like that they included cotton gloves to keep your hands clean during assembly.Can't say enough good things.

author: Rex I.
body: This item has been with me for a very short time.I ordered the SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair because I was tired of feeling uncomfortable and achy after long hours at my computer. The 3D flip armrests caught my eye because they allow for more customization and comfort while sitting, which is super important to me. Additionally, the 3D headrest seemed like a great feature to help support my neck and reduce strain during those late nights working. I also appreciated the sleek design and high-quality materials used in construction, it just looked like a chair that would last me a long time.I hope you find this review helpful.

author: J. C.
body: Easy to construct, took me about 10 minutes by myself.  It is quite the comfy chair for long hours at the desk. It's got armrests that flip out of the way, which is handy if you need more space or just don't need them. The headrest and lumbar support can be tweaked too, making it quite versatile for different body types. The seat height adjusts smoothly, so you can get your posture just right. I really loved all these ergonomic options - if you adjust it right, this could be the most comfortable chair you've ever had to sit in. A really solid choice if you're looking to upgrade your home office setup.

author: Ramon
body: nice looking good for the valueeasy to assemble and prettycomfortable

author: Alastorr
body: Nice affordable mesh chair, it's adjustable for best comfort. Well made and sturdy. Took about 15mins to put together very simple, the wheels are not great for my needs but they are easily replace, the back support is great

author: A Discerning I.
body: This ergonomic desk chair arrived disassembled, in new condition, and adequately protected within a branded box. The assembly hardware was easy to find due to it being contained in a blister pack of sorts. The chairs components feel well made and the castors roll well. It is comfortable enough for my needs. Overall, I like it.

author: Swami
body: Got this chair to replace an aging bonded leather chair. Some observations from my use - ? ASSEMBLY - All parts were well organized and labeled. The screws and tool came in a neatly labeled packet making it super easy to identify (see second picture) what goes where. Most of the screws had one extra provided - a nice touch. On the whole it was a joy putting this chair together. One note - attaching the back of the chair to the base was the only step where I needed help because both pieces were heavy and needed to be properly aligned. ? FINISH - This chair is put together really nicely. All the polycarbonate pieces have metal threading, and almost all screws came with washers. Once fully assembled, the chair feels sturdy. ? USABILITY and COMFORT - After about a week's use, the chair is mostly comfortable except for 2 areas - (1) the lumbar support while adaptive is not adjustable so it feels like you need to sit in specific positions to get good support, and (2) the headrest design is such that I could not find a comfortable angle, the headrest needs to be more rotatableOverall a decent chair but with some shortcomings.

author: human X.
body: The design of the chair is very ergonomic, and it provides all-round support when you sit on it. What satisfies me most is its 3D swivel armrests and 3D headrest. The armrests can adjust the angle according to my sitting posture, which is very convenient, especially when typing or using the computer for a long time, the arms can be well supported, reducing fatigue in the shoulders and wrists. The 3D adjustment design of the headrest is also very considerate. It can be adjusted according to different heights and needs. Yes, when I relax my back slightly, the headrest can support my head well and avoid neck pain. The adjustable design of the lumbar support is also a highlight. It can be adjusted according to my waist curve to provide precise support. I will not feel uncomfortable even if I sit for a long time, which solves the common waist pain problem in the past. The adjustable waist height function is also very flexible. It can be easily adjusted according to the height of the desktop to ensure that the sitting posture remains in the most comfortable position.

author: Peter and S.
body: This chair is pretty comfortable most of the time and it has many features I've been wanting in a chair for some time. I think the support is good, the head rest is comfortable enough and very adjustable, the arms rests move in many ways including up and out of the way. (Actually, the arms are a little too easy to adjust and sometimes they move in ways I don't want them too) The thing I don't like about it, is you are either very upright when sitting or you can lean back really far. There isn't a way to set the leaning back to be less far back. Also, the back of the chair is all that leans back so your bottom and legs stay but the back and upper body all go back. I think I like it better when the whole chair leans back. Also, the arms are not able to support a lot of weight so if you rely on the arms to help you stand up, don't get this! Overall, I like this chair and I plan to keep it at my desk for years to come but I don't think I would have liked paying more than $200 USD for it.

author: human X.
body: The 3D support is especially useful. The adjustable angle allows me to customize it based on my sitting posture, relieving neck pressure significantly. The 3D headrest also adds comfort, providing great support for my head and neck, preventing discomfort during extended sitting. The lumbar support is adjustable as well, and it fits my spine perfectly.

author: jorge
body: I am absolutely thrilled with this ergonomic office chair that I recently acquired. The computer chair with 3D flip-up armrests, 3D headrest, and lumbar support offers exceptional comfort for long hours of work. The adjustable seat height allows for perfect customization for an ergonomic posture. Aside from being extremely comfortable, this chair is visually appealing and stylish, making it a stylish addition to any home office space. The ease of assembly was a plus, and the quality of the materials is evident in every detail. I would definitely recommend this desk chair to anyone looking for comfort, style, and quality in one product.

author: The End U.
body: This chair has been a serious upgrade from my old one. The lower back support is great, the arms raise up and pop forward or back, and the headrest isn't flimsy. The mesh support for the seat is very comfortable as well. Don't expect to be able to sit cross legged on it for long however, as the front bend is kind of hard on the ankles/legs.I'd give this 5 stars if the product page was more than just one picture. I took a risk requesting this item and for the current price I wouldn't have done that with other purchases.

author: SFC
body: Very nice sturdy mesh style office desk chair. It has a soldi metal base smooth casters. The mesh provides a cool feel and great for someone like me who usually sweats easily sitting too long. Assembly instructions were clear and easy to follow.

author: SFC
body: Very nice office chair. Solid and very sturdy feeling. Comfortable mesh with extended lumbar for better support. Pretty easy to put together with all the parts labeled and clear instructions.

author: A Discerning I.
body: This office chair arrived in new condition and adequately packaged inside of a branded box. So far, everything I have experienced with this chair has been exceptional. The instructions were well written in, available in multiple languages, and professionally produced as though there was not a max expenditure limit in the budget. The castors are heavy and feel superior to most I have experienced regarding office chairs. Easy enough to assemble. Comfortable. Yes!

author: Customer R.
body: I put this chair together in about 15 minutes. The instructions were clear, and extra hardware was included just in case. It is comfortable to sit in, and I love the option to flip up the armrests when I need extra space. Overall, it is a high-quality chair that should last, and I am very satisfied with my purchase.

author: Billy and L.
body: Comfortable and adaptable chair.  The all mesh material is actually really comfortable and very breathable (no more swamp butt).  The lumbar looks pronounced, but it's almost like it has shock absorbers because you can feel when you sit that it's moving to fit you.  I didn't like the headrest much but it was easy to remove and use without.  Recommended especially if you tend to get really warm after sitting a long time.

author: Matthew C.
body: What an excellent chair! It holds up great. And, it was easy to put together. The size allows for much more comfort. And the features are stellar. This is my new work chair, as it will help over long hours of sitting. I might even use it as my gaming chair... but then I have to move it between room. I'll have to ponder that.

author: James
body: Ordered this office chair to replace my leather one that had seen better days.  This office chair is easy to assemble and comes with everything required to put it together.  This chair is very comfortable for all day use, I normally sit for about six of my nine hours a day.  This chair has very nice rolling casters which do not seem to get stuck on my plastic floor protector.  This chair also has a lot of adjustments from the headrest to the lumbar support and are easy to manipulate. I like that I have the option to flip up the armrest if I need to get closer to my computer monitors.Overall, a very nice office chair.

author: Anonymous J.
body: This ergnomic office chair is adjust in many ways. It holds about 330 pounds. The armrests, headrest, and lumbar adjust and of course it swivels. This isn't a cushy chair, but it's breathable. It takes a lot to put this together and a star is off for instructions. I'm not sure I'd recommend this chair, but it's not bad.

author: Nieke
body: This office chair provide great lumbar support for a big person like me. Arm rest are adjustable front to back and left to right.  The mesh is high quality and nicely support your body.I like the design and color of the chair. It match my home office

author: Monica M.
body: My previous chair had me falling out of it too many times so I got this beauty. Super easy to assemble, it took me about 15-20 minutes which is saying much since I'm not the most assembly oriented. It is so comfortable and supports my lower back issues when sitting for too long. Everything works fine and even after sitting in it every day for 2 weeks straight it is still holding up. At first I didn't think I would like the mesh but now I've grown accustomed to it.

author: kinoki r.
body: I ordered this chair with high hopes. First, it came with super easy to follow, detailed instructions. Putting it together was so simple and straightforward. Second, I noticed that the parts feel sturdy and nice quality. Everything went together nicely and the chair feels durable. Lastly, this wasn't advertised as highback and while my 6'2 son is happy with it at 5'5 it is too big for me. At the lowest setting the neck hits me too high.My son likes the versatility of the neck rest. The double hinge design allows for better angling of the neck rest. He said it is comfortable and helps eliminate some fatigue. He can go longer between stretch breaks. His only complaint is he would've preferred the lumbar area to be firmer.

author: Jeffrey J.
body: The SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair offers a comfortable and customizable seating experience. Its 3D flip armrests and headrest provide adjustable support, while the adaptive lumbar pillow ensures proper back alignment. The saddle-shaped cushion relieves pressure during long sitting periods, and the high-quality mesh promotes breathability. This chair is a solid choice for enhancing comfort and productivity in the workspace.

author: SFC
body: Sturdy and comfortable mesh chair. It has a nice cool feel. Solid metal base with smooth wheels. It has some good comfort overall. The seat is mesh as well. Support is decent compared to foam cushion. A foam cushion probably has better overall support.

author: Rico
body: This took me about 15 minutes to put together. The instructions were clear and there was extra hardware included in case you lose any. It??s nice and comfy to sit in and having the option to flip up the armrests is great. Very good quality and overall it??s a solid chair that should last.

author: Alexis.F
body: this office chair beats my gaming chair by an mile! it gives great overall support where the areas are needed.  the headrest is not great, depending on the angle you get no support or feels horrible.

author: Tater T.
body: This lightweight easy rolling office chair is very comfortable and adjustable. It took about 15 minutes to assemble with clear instructions. The seating area of the chair is all mesh and sits comfortable. Since it is a mesh it's perfect for those people who tend to get hot or sweaty in a leather or leather-like chair. Very pleased with this chair, great product!

author: Jo S.
body: Good quality comfy easy to use

author: K m.
body: I got this to replace a gaming chair that was beginning to come apart. It could not withstand a full time work schedule of use. This chair does not have the typical foam cushion seat. It has tightly stretched woven mesh. It is actually more supportive than it looks. The flip up armrests are genius! I don't have to adjust my seat height to push the chair in ever. If I could have a wishlist item, it would be adjustable back height. The lumbar support falls just short of where I really want it to be. Overall, this chair is supportive and it's unique design feels like it moves with me. So far, it's comfortable and holding up well.

author: Jenny and J.
body: I'm writing this review after daily driving this chair for over a month and a half now.  I'm surprisingly surprised at how good this chair feels! The mesh circulates air to your back and bottom and it keeps it cool.  Also there's support in all the right areas.  I can sit in it for hours and not feel much discomfort.  The arms are a hard plastic though so that may turn some people off but honestly most of the time my arms are near my desk so I don't use the arm rests much.  The only thing I don't like about this chair is that it does creak and crack due to a mostly plastic construction.  It's a bit of a minor complaint.  I changed wheels to better clear rubber ones to not scuff up my floor.  I think this chair is great! super comfortable and very supportive.  I am extremely pleasantly surprised given the price range.  I think buying super expensive chairs give incredibly diminishing returns in the end.  This chair really fits the bill for me.

author: Bigboyuber
body: The SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair is an excellent choice for those seeking comfort and support during long hours at the desk. Its 3D flip armrests and 3D headrest provide customizable support, while the adjustable seat height and lumbar support ensure a perfect fit for your body. The vibrant red color adds a stylish touch to any office space. Highly recommended for its ergonomic design and adjustability!

author: Jinfrey
body: I find this chair quite comfortable. During long work-from-home days, it's made a noticeable difference. The 3D flip armrests are clever, letting me adjust easily, whether I'm typing or taking a short rest. My back feels relieved, and I approach my work sessions with more anticipation now. I'd suggest it to anyone who prioritizes comfort and adaptability.

author: Jinfrey
body: Surprisingly, this chair really supports me during long workdays. I've noticed how the dual back design and lumbar support align with my needs. Those armrests flip up easily, allowing for more space when necessary. It seems like this chair finally gets what sitting for hours requires. Sitting no longer feels burdensome. This is a solid choice for anyone who spends a lot of time at their desk.

author: CrazyTattooedLady
body: My grandson desperately needed a new desk chair. His gaming chair fell apart and I decided (since he lives with me) to get him this chair as an early Christmas present. The second it arrived, he brought it up to his room and assembled it. Assembly was easy enough and he had it together in about 20 minutes. He loves it! He said it's more comfortable than his gaming chair. Sturdy, durable, and well made. Highly recommend.

author: Amazon C.
body: This chair is so comfortable and supportive! The adjustable armrests and ergonomic design make it perfect for long hours at the desk. It was easy to assemble, and the build quality feels solid.

author: Chantel S.
body: This ergonomic design is really functional. The height can be adjusted and is stable. Gives great back support. Comfortable sitting for long periods of time

author: Amz
body: I've been using a mesh chair for a number of years now and I've grown better attached to how airy it is, to avoid the sweat building up in the back or on the bottom during summer.  This is a great quality chair with lots of adjustment I could make and still support a 190-lb male without any problem and squeak.

author: Stephanie K.
body: I have wanted a mesh chair for a while, especially during hot weather. This one is a great alternative to pricier $400+ models. It was easy to assemble and offers strong ergonomic support. It may not feel as heavy-duty as high-end chairs, but for the price, it is an excellent value.

author: Mike B.
body: The SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair has completely changed my home office setup. The 3D flip armrests, adjustable headrest, and lumbar support are top-notch. Build quality is exceptional with smooth wheels and a sleek design. Highly recommend.

author: Troy
body: Initial impressions were excellent. Assembly took about 25 minutes, instructions were clear, and chair is extremely comfortable. Headrest adjusts well, and flip-up armrests are convenient. Sturdy and high-quality.

author: Leah S.
body: This chair is supportive and adjustable, making it a solid choice for long hours at a desk. The lumbar support and 3D armrests help with posture, and the 3D headrest is comfortable. The seat height adjusts easily, and the chair feels sturdy. It is a little tricky to assemble, but the comfort is definitely worth the effort.

author: an2ny79
body: This chair is not only stylish but also very comfortable. The lumbar pillows adjust automatically with your movements, offering continuous support for your lower back. The breathable mesh keeps me cool during long work hours, and the flip-up armrests are great for flexibility. Whether for work, gaming, or everyday use, this chair combines ergonomic design with sleek style.

author: Farr
body:
I recently got the SIHOO Ergonomic Office Chair, and I must say, it is incredibly comfortable! The design is perfect for long sitting sessions, and the armrests provide excellent support during my workdays. However, I did encounter an issue with the hydraulic pump, which does not seem to work properly. I tried taking it apart and reassembling it, but it still does not function as expected. As someone who is taller, this has made it a bit uncomfortable for long periods, since I can not adjust the chair height.

Despite the hydraulic issue, the chair is still quite comfortable, and if that was resolved, it would be a perfect fit for my needs. I would recommend it, but just be aware of potential quality control issues.

author: Gregory K.
body: I was surprised by just how firm the support in this chair was without it being hard as a rock or comfortable to sit in long term.I have a desk job that often has me tied to my chairs for hours at a time. In that situation it means I need ti make sure any chair I have supports my lower back and this one does that very well.

author: Fleur N.
body: Where do I begin? This chair is beyond a 10/10. It is comfortable, functional, and backed by outstanding customer support. Every interaction has been positive, and the chair truly delivers.

author: Ross T.
body: Love that the arms fold up so I can play instruments more easily. Great product!

author: Dale H.
body: The SIHOO M59AS Ergonomic Office Chair has transformed my home office setup. Assembly was easy, taking about 20 minutes. The 3D headrest and 3D flip armrests provide exceptional support and customization. The lumbar support is firm yet comfortable, and the mesh seat keeps me cool. Highly recommended.

author: Gail
body: Be prepared to ask for help when bringing this box inside because it is heavy and large! There is a lot of cardboard packaging in addition to the chair itself. All hardware is included, with an extra of each piece, plus an Allen wrench for assembly. The instructions are straightforward, making assembly easy. Once put together, it is a very comfortable office chair.

author: Alex S.
body: Easy to assemble! Nothing missing. Fast shipping.

author: Paula
body: After spending hours at my computer desk, my back and head were constantly hurting. This chair has been a game-changer. The lumbar support alone is worth the price. The wheels are convenient for gliding around the room, and the flip-up armrests save space. The height is adjustable, and the seat is well-padded. I have not had a backache in a week, and I feel so much better.

author: Boyi F.
body: It is a great chair. I have used over 3 weeks. So far I like it a lot

author: Anthony G.
body: Really confortable

author: Beck N.
body: After using this chair for a while, I am really happy with it. The ergonomic design makes long work sessions more comfortable, and I do not feel tired after sitting for hours.

author: Amazon C.
body: Great seat - the arm rests are not sturdiest.  Very comfortable otherwise.  Easy to assemble.

author: Leslie M.
body: I ordered this for my husband, who is 6 feet 3 inches tall, and it is perfect for him. Assembly was quick, and he loves the lumbar support. The armrests are great because he can flip them up when needed. Although he does not sit in it for long stretches, he finds it comfortable, and the chair seems durable.

author: Dzo
body: This chair is a perfect fit for smaller individuals. It offers full ergonomic support and high adjustability. Great materials, solid comfort, and excellent build quality.

author: Brandi M. L.
body: This chair is really nice. It was not too difficult to assemble, with all hardware clearly marked and separated. The instructions were decent, but not perfect. The chair is a bit firm, but I noticed that my lower back did not hurt after sitting in it all day. The adjustable headrest is a great feature, and the seat height is also easily adjustable. The armrests can flip up out of the way, making it easier to push the chair under the desk or to not use them at all. Overall, I definitely prefer this chair over my old one. I would recommend it.

author: human X.
body: The chair design is very ergonomic. The lumbar support is excellent, and the backrest curve fits my spine perfectly, ensuring a comfortable sitting posture. What I love most is the 3D armrests and headrest. Both are adjustable in terms of angle and height, so you can find the ideal position for your sitting posture. The large seat gives plenty of room for comfort, and I do not feel cramped even after sitting for extended periods. This chair has made long work sessions much more comfortable.

author: Hao C.
body: great chair great support great price

author: Hublet a. W.
body: I have built many office chairs this year and this is by far the best. Supports weight well, assembly is intuitive, and joints and flipping mechanisms are well-executed. The chair is very comfortable and ideal for larger users.

author: john m.
body: After three days of use, the chair is incredibly comfortable. Mesh is durable and adjustments are easy. Headrest could move forward or backward for better support but overall very satisfied.

author: Amazon c.
body:
Good chair for home office
Reviewed in the United States on April 27, 2025

The chair is easy to assemble, made with good materials, and after a couple of months of use, we haven’t had any issues. The only thing that could be improved is the wheels, as they can get a bit stiff on certain surfaces, but overall, it’s a very solid chair.Keep in mind it’s a bit heavy, but that just means it should be able to handle most people without a problem!!

author: J s.
body:
Great Chair
You need look no farther for a comfortable, long-lasting, and adjustable office chair that will increase your comfort and productivity. After a few months of use, I can genuinely say that this chair was well worth the investment. This is a great option whether you're working from home, in the office, or simply need a cozy chair for your study space!

author: Keith
body:
Great value, very comfortable for older gamer, with lower back issues.
I'm very happy with this purchase, and I'm surprised at how much I enjoy this chair. The chair has corrected my posture while I'm doing office work and gaming. The lumbar support is perfect and has eliminated the lower back pain I had with my previous chair. The firmer seat cushion has helped alleviate fatigue when sitting for extended periods.

author: David
body:
Decent chair for the money
It's a pretty decent chair for the price. The lumbar support isn't as strong as I'd like but otherwise it's pretty comfortable. I wish the headrest could be rotated all the way back to get it out of the way and I wish the lumbar was more effective.

author: Farr
body: The 3D headrest and lumbar support help maintain excellent posture. Flip-up armrests are easy to adjust. The mesh back is breathable and the seat is supportive. Definitely an upgrade.

author: Andrei
body: Great chair in every point of view when it comes to confort and materials EXCEPT for one thing… the headrest can’t  be stretched way back or rotated 180 for when you want to lean your head back and lay low. It will always push your head forward unless you remove it and put it back on when you want to have a straight position which is not very practical in a conference. It is almost perfect

author: Christina
body: Shipping was super fast and the chair was easy to put together. So far it is comfortable. The only negative in my mind is that the lumbar support is not adjustable as I need support a little higher up. That was fixable by buying a lumbar pillow, but I was hoping to not have to do that.

author: Jesse
body:
Outstanding Comfort & Support – Beats My Old Haworth Chair by a Mile!
I purchased this Sihoo Ergonomic Office Chair after a recent back injury that’s forced me to spend more time sitting, and I’m genuinely impressed. From day one, the comfort and support have made a noticeable difference in my posture and pain levels.I had a few concerns after assembling it, but I reached out to the seller and was met with quick, helpful, and informative customer service. something I really appreciated.For context, I previously used a Haworth Improv HE chair for over 10 years, and this new Sihoo chair easily outperforms it in every way. My girlfriend has a True Innovations ergonomic chair from Costco in a similar price range, and while I initially liked hers, we both agree the Sihoo chair is far superior. The adjustable lumbar support is a standout feature, it offers much better customization for different body types and sitting styles. Another huge plus: the breathable mesh back and seat. I tend to sweat easily, especially when seated for long periods, and the mesh design keeps things cool and comfortable throughout the day. Highly recommend this chair to anyone dealing with back issues or looking to upgrade their home office setup. Excellent value for the price!

author: Kristin L.
body:
Nice desk chair
Well made, durable and sturdy. Supportive and comfortable. Breathable material. Easy to assemble. Priced a little high in my opinion but the chair is a great chair.

author: Dean
body: good build quality but they advertised it as appropriate for shorter people. it's not.

author: Steven V.
body:
Excellent chair at an excellent price
I work from home and had been thinking of getting a real office chair for my kitchen table desk. A YouTube ad for this product got me thinking it was about time to buy one. The built-in lumbar support, a head rest that stuck way out enough compared to other office chairs I had looked at, and the sale price in the ad compelled me to actually buy this one, hoping I didn't later have buyer's remorse. And I have not. The unit was incredibly easy to assemble with the instructions and provided tool. The parts were packaged with incredibly efficiency as there was only one small cardboard spacer for what little unused space there was in the box. The package even included a pair of cotton gloves which I didn't need as I didn't get dirty from the assembly. But still, nice touch. The rollers are nice enough to my floor that I didn't bother getting a floor mat. I wish the lumbar support was a little more aggressive, and that the head rest pushed out a couple of more inches, but these are both still good enough for the price I paid for this chair. I've been using it for a month and have no real complaints.

author: Hope
body:
Pretty good worth the money
It’s a pretty good chair a better upgrade from my previous one that gave me a lot of back pain especially if im sitting for hours playing games. It is pretty comfortable. Everything is exactly to the measurements well not that im complaining.

author: Vincent
body: At first, this chair seemed like a solid purchase. It was comfortable, and everything appeared sturdy. However, within just a few days, the backrest started to come loose, making the chair increasingly uncomfortable to sit in. The support simply isn't there anymore, and it feels like it's only a matter of time before it completely falls apart. For the price, I expected much better durability. If you're looking for something long-lasting, I'd recommend exploring other options.

author: Anastasiia
body: My son absolutely loves this chair. He finds it very comfortable and often spends hours sitting in it while studying or using his computer, without complaining about discomfort or back pain.

author: Jose
body: This chair feels like a great find. It is comfortable, affordable, and very easy to clean, which makes it ideal for daily use. It honestly feels like a jackpot for my back and neck support.

author: Craig
body: The Sihoo M59AS was very straightforward to assemble thanks to clear and easy-to-follow instructions. The chair itself is extremely comfortable, with supportive back and head areas and breathable mesh seating that makes it the best chair I have owned so far for the price.

author: Celia
body: I love this chair overall. Delivery was fast, packaging was secure, and after just a short time of use, my back already feels noticeably better compared to my old office chair.

author: nekane
body: The chair is genuinely comfortable, especially the backrest and breathable mesh seat. The airflow helps keep things cool during long work hours, while still providing enough support to maintain a good sitting posture.

author: Axelle
body: While the assembly took a moment to get right, the final result is well worth it! This chair is flexible, high-quality, and a absolute pleasure to sit on every day.

author: Aljoscha
body: I really like the design of this chair. It looks clean and modern without being flashy, and it is very functional for everyday office tasks, whether working from home or studying for long hours.

author: Marin
body: This is a very good office chair that delivers an excellent seating experience. The recline function is smooth and relaxing, allowing short breaks without fully leaving the desk.

author: JRme
body: Assembly was simple thanks to the clear instructions included with the Sihoo M59AS. Once set up, the chair provides an impressive level of comfort that makes long work sessions much easier on the body.

author: Christiane
body: The precise and clearly illustrated assembly instructions made building the Sihoo M59AS simple and stress-free. Once assembled, the seating experience is excellent, offering good balance between firmness and comfort.

author: Felo
body: I am impressed with both the customer service and the comfort of the Sihoo M59AS. Support responses were quick and helpful, and the chair itself provides consistent comfort during long sitting sessions without causing back or shoulder fatigue.

author: Christopher
body: The Sihoo M59AS is a comfortable and easy-to-assemble chair with a sleek design that fits well in a modern office. Overall, I am very satisfied with the quality and comfort and would recommend it to others.

author: Fabrice
body: The Sihoo M59AS does exactly what it promises. From the design to the comfort level, everything feels spot on, making it a reliable and practical ergonomic chair for daily use.

author: SEERY,
body: The build quality of the Sihoo M59AS is solid, and assembly was surprisingly easy. I appreciated that the included hex key is well-made and sturdy, not the cheap kind that bends easily, and it is useful beyond just this chair.

author: Thomas
body: The design of the Sihoo M59AS looks cool and modern, and more importantly, it is very comfortable to sit in for extended periods of time without feeling stiff or overheated.

author: BASTIEN
body: This chair feels top-tier for its price range. The seat is supportive and comfortable, and the instructions were clear enough that I completed assembly in about thirty minutes. Once assembled, the chair feels sturdy and dependable for daily use.

author: mariem
body: After several days of use, everything about the Sihoo M59AS has been positive so far. The chair feels comfortable, stable, and supportive, and I am very satisfied with this purchase overall.

author: Leigh A.
body:
Wow, I did not realize how much of a difference the right chair could make for my back and neck. As a 5 ft 5 in female, this chair feels like a perfect fit. The seat size and weight capacity give me a comfortable amount of extra space on either side without feeling oversized.

The lumbar support provides noticeable lower back relief, and the headrest supports my neck in a natural position. The armrests are also well positioned and easy to adjust, making long hours at my desk much more comfortable.

The printed directions could be a bit clearer, but the assembly itself is manageable, and there are helpful videos available that make the process even easier. Overall, I am very pleased with how supportive and comfortable this chair is.

author: Dario M.
body: This product was received as expected. I purchased it to be use in my home office

author: CJ A.
body: The product feels great. It can be adjusted to fit your needs. Installation was a breeze, everything fit nicely and was labeled. 10/10.

author: Ezekiel
body: Great chair head rest is a little bit of a nuisance but other than that its a good chair

author: Nick
body: I actually really like the chair but I got it for 220$ on sale instead of the 400$ like normal.
